heroSubtitles: {brand} bakes pretzels and cakes the German way and pours filter coffee all day, in a calm room made for a long chat.
Come for warm apple strudel and a pot of coffee, stay for a slow afternoon. {brand} is a small cafe with a German menu.
From soft pretzels at breakfast to bratwurst at lunch and Black Forest cake after, {brand} keeps a simple German menu.
featureTitle: A German Menu For Every Part Of The Day

features.title: Fresh Pretzels
features.text: Soft salted pretzels baked through the day, served plain, with butter or with mustard.

features.title: Black Forest Cake
features.text: Layers of chocolate sponge, cherries and cream, the classic cake of the Black Forest.

features.title: Apple Strudel
features.text: Thin pastry around spiced apples and raisins, served warm with vanilla sauce.

features.title: Bratwurst And Mustard
features.text: Grilled German sausages with mustard and bread, for a proper lunch at the cafe.

features.title: Filter Coffee
features.text: Freshly brewed filter coffee by the cup or the pot, the German way to start a slow morning.

features.title: Kaffee Und Kuchen
features.text: A pot of coffee and a slice of cake in the afternoon, a German habit we are happy to share.

items.title: Find A Table
items.text: Pick a table inside or by the window, or reserve one for a group.

items.title: Order At The Counter
items.text: Choose pretzels, cake or a hot plate and a pot of coffee.

items.title: Sit And Stay
items.text: Take your time: the coffee comes to the table and refills are easy.

items.title: Take Cake Home
items.text: Ask for a boxed slice or a whole cake to share at home.

faq.q: Do I need to reserve a table?
faq.a: Walk-ins are welcome. For a group or a birthday, message us and we will keep a table ready.
Yes. Pretzels, strudel, cakes and many bakes are vegetarian; ask the team about each dish.
It is a medium roast brewed fresh. Ask for it stronger or lighter and we will adjust.

faq.q: Can I order a whole cake?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the cake and the day, and we will confirm if it can be ready.
Ask the team which sausages are on the menu today and what they are made of.

about.title: About Our German Cafe
paragraphs: {brand} is a small German cafe that bakes pretzels, strudel and cakes and brews filter coffee all day.
The menu is simple and homely: the cakes and bakes of a German coffee house, served at a pace that lets you stay.
points: A calm room for long chats

testimonials.quote: The pretzels were warm and soft and the cake tasted like it came from a German bakery.
A quiet place for a long coffee and a slice of strudel, easy to spend an afternoon here.
We booked a table for six and the team kept it ready with coffee on arrival.
